tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
all terms and conditions as per tender document

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Proforma statement of the orders up to at least 80% (i.e. 4,00,000 Nos) for the primary manufacturer and up to at least 30% (i.e. 1,50,000 Nos) for the authorized representative/agent of a manufacturer of the scheduled requirement of the tender for the supply of D Pharma theory answer Scripts / OMR Answer booklets with QR code on all the pages containing 32 pages of A4 size in any one of last three years (i.e. 2021-22, 2022-23 and 2023-24) in Section - XII and the Performance Statement / Satisfactory Certificates of the same should be submitted.

Self-Declaration stating that the tenderer have not been black listed by any government department or Quasi Govt. Organizations or Public Undertaking Sectors and will not supply Refurbished materials and is not facing any judicial enquiry
Earnest Money Deposit (EMD) should be paid and receipt (proof) of the same should be submitted as per Section - IX.
The bidder has to upload the copy of the PAN Card.
Self-Attested Valid Registration Certificate of GST.
Information in Section - XIV Proforma for items / goods and quality control employed by the manufacturer to be submitted.

If the tenderer is the primary manufacturer, the declaration of primary manufacturer in Section - XV as applicable to be submitted. If the tenderer is other than the primary manufacturer, the Authorization letter from the Primary manufacturer should be in the format provided as per Section - XIII to be submitted.
Technical Specifications should be filled (compulsorily with model no, part no and if any other required details), signed, and submitted as per Section - VI.
Copy of valid Firm registration / Company incorporation certificate.
